start: A gym with one member called Preeti Sharma

steps.action: Ask "Priti ka plan kab khatam hoga"
user_sees: A one-member card for Preeti Sharma straight away
must_not: "Which one?" when only one fits
A member invented by the AI
An archived member

user_sees: A renew card with Member "Preeti Sharma" in bold
must_not: A member whose name is one letter off used without the card naming who

start: A gym with three members whose first name is Rahul

user_sees: A card with "3 members are called Rahul. Which one?" and one button a member: full name and plan
Members with a running plan first
must_not: One of them picked silently
A count that differs from the buttons shown
A Rahul left out with no way to reach him

user_sees: The payment card for that member
must_not: The card for another Rahul
The question asked to the AI again (a second count of the day)

start: A member called Rahul Singh; the owner speaks in Hindi

steps.action: Say a request; the heard words hold "राहुल सिंह"
must_not: "Nobody called राहुल सिंह is on your members list"

steps.action: Type loose spellings: "Wikas" for Vikas, "Puja" for Pooja, "Dr. Neha" for Neha
must_not: A title or a spelling habit makes the member not found

start: No member called Zoya on the list

user_sees: A card "No member found": "Nobody called “Zoya” is on your members list."
A button "Add Zoya as a new member"
must_not: Figures for a different member
A blank card

steps.action: Tap "Add Zoya as a new member"
user_sees: An add-member card with Name "Zoya", nothing saved yet
must_not: The member saved at once

user_sees: The message card says nobody of that name was found, with no add button
must_not: A message drafted for everyone instead

start: A member called Imran Khan was archived last month

user_sees: A plain word that he is archived, or the choice to bring him back
must_not: Only "Add Imran as a new member", which makes a second record for the same person
A payment saved against an archived member without a word

steps.action: A member's name is corrected on another device, then asked for by the new name
user_sees: Found by the new name after the sync
must_not: Only the old name works

start: The owner names a member in a request

user_sees: The match is made on the device against the gym's own list
must_not: The members list is sent to the AI to find her
Other members' names are sent as choices
